NOTE: Despite appearing in searches for "eighth night," this CENTCOM release is dated JULY 13, 2026 — NOT a new eighth-night strike. Recorded here to prevent misdating.

Text: "TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) completed the latest wave of strikes against Iran at 10:15 p.m. ET on July 13. During the five-hour mission, U.S. forces successfully struck military targets across Iran including Bushehr, Chah Bahar, Jask, Konarak, Abu Musa, and Bandar Abbas to further degrade Iran's ability to attack commercial shipping. CENTCOM forces employed precision munitions against Iranian coastal defense systems, missile and drone sites, and maritime capabilities. More than 50,000 U.S. service members are currently deployed across the Middle East. American forces remain vigilant, lethal, and ready."

LATEST CONFIRMED STRIKE as of 18 July morning = SEVENTH consecutive night (completed Friday 17 July), per CNN live blog 18 July and Al Jazeera. No eighth-night CENTCOM release found at time of research (~09:00 BST 18 July).
